attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012178727 (CC0): the black screen front with its coping, the pale grey T-panel and the two planted walls, the cut-out elephant with its pink neon outline, XXX tie and rose, the marquee with the gilt THEATRE CASA ROSSO letters (Cinzel, SIL OFL 1.1, as an approximation of the sign's serif), the gabled canopy with its medallion and pink pig figures, the posts with gilt triangles and the roller shutter with the painted elephant, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
